ideas.title: Minnesota's Feeding Our Future Program: A Case Study in COVID-19 Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future program and its role in the alleged $250M COVID-19 meal fraud scheme
ideas.angle: Follow the money: tracing the flow of funds in the Feeding Our Future program
questions: What was the extent of the fraud?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future program presents a critical case study of COVID-19 fraud in Minnesota. Investigating this program can reveal key insights into the mechanisms of fraud and the challenges of oversight.

ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Fraud on Minnesota's Healthcare System
ideas.description: Explore the effects of Medicaid fraud on Minnesota's healthcare system and the state's efforts to combat it
ideas.angle: Analyzing the financial and systemic impacts of Medicaid fraud
questions: What is the scale of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How does it affect the healthcare system?
ideas.insight: Understanding the impact of Medicaid fraud on Minnesota's healthcare system can inform policy and improve oversight. This story can provide critical insights into the challenges faced by the state in combating fraud.
